utterance: Hi Chloe, thanks for coming in today. Can you tell me more about the burning when you go to the toilet?
reply: It stings and burns, especially at the end when I finish weeing. I’ve been going a lot — maybe every half hour — but only a little comes out each time. It’s been like this since yesterday morning. The urine is a bit cloudy and smells, but I haven’t seen any blood.

awards.label: How long the symptoms have been present
Colour of the urine or any visible blood

finding: Soft abdomen. Mild suprapubic tenderness. No guarding or rebound. No masses.

utterance: Have you had any pain in your lower back or sides?
reply: No, nothing in my back. Just a bit of an ache low down in my tummy.

awards.label: Red flag excluded: Pain in the back or sides (loins)

utterance: Have you had a urinary tract infection before?
reply: I had one UTI about two years ago, that's it.
I was given antibiotics and it cleared up after a few days.

utterance: I'm going to order a urine test to check for infection. We'll get the results in a few days.
reply: Okay, I guess that's the plan. I just want to get back to work and not feel so uncomfortable.

awards.label: First-line antibiotic: nitrofurantoin 100 mg 6-hourly for 5 days, fosfomycin 3 g once, or trimethoprim 300 mg daily for 3 days

utterance: I've prescribed you a 3-day course of trimethoprim to treat your UTI. You should start feeling better within a few days. If your symptoms don't improve or get worse, please come back to see me. Drink plenty of water to help flush out your system.
reply: Thanks, I'll start the pills today. I hope they work fast so I can get back to work without any problems.
